answer: Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 7 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, as a result paying the basalt bond on all of them and exposing each to the tide slash. Because the whisper audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Bonded capital sits idle for 5 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
